name: does-not-rebuild-supply-chain-security
description: The single most likely failure for an agent that cannot see the repository: proposing image signing that has shipped since day one. This case records what that mistake looks like and asserts the gate rejects it.
intent: I'd like our container images to be signed so we know they came from our own pipeline.

fixture.note: The rewrite an agent produces when it cannot see that cosign, Syft and Trivy have been in this pipeline since day one — a ten-line workflow replacing a two-hundred-line one.

changeSets.summary: Added cosign keyless signing to the Go service CI workflow so images are signed by the pipeline.

files.contents:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  sign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@v3
      - run: cosign sign --yes "$IMAGE"
